name: Mountain phlox
desc: Mountain phlox (Phlox ovata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phlox ovata, the Allegheny phlox, mountain phlox, or wideflower phlox, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polemoniaceae, native to the eastern United States.
